title: Your boards
subtitle: A board is a split-flap display you leave open on a TV and drive from your phone — type your own message, or let the AI write one.

empty.title: No boards yet
empty.body: A board is a split-flap display you open on your TV and drive from your phone — type your own message, or let the AI write one.

create.title: New board
create.description: Give it a name so you can tell your boards apart. Blank is fine.

error.name_too_long: That name is too long — keep it to {{max}} characters.
error.create_failed: The board wasn't created. Try again.

card.tv_label: Type this into your TV's browser
card.copy_manual: Selected — copy it with your keyboard

rename.title: Rename board
rename.description: Give this board a new name. It won't change its address or its history.

error.name_too_long: That name is too long — keep it to {{max}} characters.
error.rename_failed: The board wasn't renamed. Try again.

revoke.title: Unpair every phone from "{{name}}"?
revoke.description: Every phone that scanned this board loses control immediately, and the code on your TV stops working until the display refreshes it a few seconds later. The board keeps its name and its history. Anyone who needs it back can scan the new code.

error.revoke_failed: The phones weren't unpaired. Try again.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: This deletes the board and everything it has ever shown — every past message is gone with it. This can't be undone.

error.delete_failed: The board wasn't deleted. Try again.

link.title: Link a TV
link.subtitle: Scan the QR on the TV — or type the code it shows.
link.success: Paired. The TV is now showing {{name}}.

failure.invalid-code: That is not a valid code. It is 6 characters, exactly as shown on the TV.
failure.no-board: Pick which board the TV should show.
failure.no-name: Give the new board a name.
failure.name_too_long: That board name is too long.
failure.create_failed: Could not create the board. Try again in a moment.
failure.not-found: No TV is waiting on that code. Check it, or reload the TV for a new one.
failure.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
failure.failed: Could not pair the TV. Try again in a moment.

auto.created: All set — we made “{{name}}” for you and the TV is showing it. Rename it anytime in Boards.
auto.paired: All set — the TV is now showing {{name}}.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.description: Phones that can drive this board, and the TVs showing it.
devices.empty: No phones are paired yet. Scan the code on the board to pair one.
devices.unpairOneBody: This phone stops being able to write to the board. Every other paired phone keeps working and nobody has to re-scan.
devices.unpairDisplaysBody: Every television showing this board goes back to the pairing screen. Paired phones are not affected.

error.revoke_device_failed: That device wasn't un-paired. Try again.
error.revoke_displays_failed: The TVs weren't un-paired. Try again.

dashboard.title: Your boards
dashboard.description: Create a split-flap board, open its address on a TV, and drive it from your phone.
